_comment: Thresholds and word lists for qc_check.py. client_names (stakeholder names the gate lists wherever they appear on a slide, for the author to confirm) is set per engagement in a local copy.

brief._note: One-slide Build Brief. Dense by design and approved as such. Hygiene, author field, placeholders and number checks still apply; page-density rules do not. Inferred when a deck is one slide headed 'Build Brief'.

_gate_exclude_note: Path fragments qc_gate_hook.py never gates: fixtures, templates' asset folders, and the .qc.pptx output of --fix-safe (gating it cascades a second block on what --fix-safe could not fix).
_totals_note: totals-sum fires only when components miss the stated total by more than 1 and by at most totals_window_pct of it (or 5 units); a wider miss means the Total is a different quantity, such as a crosstab total column.
_palette_note: palette is the house palette. A client's colors are never listed here: the gate reads them from the deck's own theme part (clrScheme and custClrLst) and treats a fill that recurs, within palette_tolerance, on palette_recurrence_slides or more slides as the deck's palette, so a brand color applied by hand is not drift. Only colors on fewer slides are reported.
_expand_note: Per engagement. A single capitalised token at the start of a paragraph (a chart label, a sentence opener) is never flagged. On the shipped federal deck the consultant kept HHS, DoD, VA, DHA and CMS as written and spelled out only DOE and, in one quote attribution, DHA; a default list of federal agencies produced 10 ignored warnings, and the short list that replaced it was one engagement's terms and fired on every deck of another client, so the shipped default is empty. Set it in a local copy for an engagement that asks for spelled-out names.
_grey_text_note: Grey text outside footnotes is listed for judgment and never blocks; above the threshold it warns. Rationale: title, body or footnote should carry everything a reader needs in a five-second scan; recurring small grey detail text is the AI habit that works against it.
_words_note: Per body page: title + body + chart labels, footnotes counted separately, appendix pages exempt. Pages where half or more of the words sit inside quotation marks are exempt (quote pages). Shipped pages across two clients ran up to about 280 words on dense deck types (kickoffs, working sessions, playbooks), so the gate warns only past 280. Warn only: length is the consultant's call, so the gate never blocks on it.
_tolerances_note: overlap_tolerance_pt: two text or chart boxes may intersect by this much before shape-overlap fires. chart_label_tolerance: a data label figure must sit within this of a cached value; labels that also carry words (n=120, 2024) warn rather than block.
